answer: An island beacon-decay bond locks 70 credits. Each epoch a spiral sweep samples 10% of island bonds; each sampled agent must show a bridge proof, a chain linking its island to its last work. A miss decays its bond by 50; two misses burn it. First fake costs 70, the k-th 70 plus 8(k-1); 1,000 fakes lock 70,000, bleed 5,000 per epoch vs a 40,000 pool. Rented bridge proofs fail: one key per spiral pass; reuse burns both. Honest agents pay 70 once.
